review_candidates.description: Job Description Operational Trainee EF Malta Campus 12-18 months Graduate Leadership Program, 40 hrs/week Start your career where education meets travel. EF Malta is one of the island's largest and most international language schools. We're proud to be both deeply rooted in Malta and connected to the world. Our students and colleagues come from across the globe – and we're excited to help ambitious graduates build an international career right here in Malta. If we were a hotel, we'd be one of the biggest on the island and one of the largest chains in the world – but we're not a hotel, an iGaming company, a consulting firm or a bank. We're an international education and travel organization, helping people learn languages, experience cultures, and broaden their horizons. Within 12–18 months, you'll gain experience that many graduates spend years acquiring. You'll work across multiple business functions, lead real projects, solve real operational challenges, and build the skills to grow into a long-term career with EF – either in Malta or internationally. Program Overview This is a paid, full-time rotational graduate program designed for recent graduates from any field of study. Our goal is simple: accelerate your career by exposing you to multiple business functions before helping you specialize where you can create the greatest impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of meaningful work – not shadow from the sidelines. You'll work alongside experienced managers, contribute ideas, and help improve the experience of thousands of international students every year. The overall length of the Graduate Leadership Program will be tailored together with you. Depending on your start date, individual development and career goals, as well as business needs, the program will typically last between 12 and 18 months. You'll have the opportunity to either attend a one-week EF language course abroad or spend time at an EF admissions office in another country, gaining valuable insight into different parts of our business while experiencing EF from a new perspective. Why graduates choose EF Broad business exposure International environment (100+ nationalities) Leadership and project management skills Learn from experienced managers Global career opportunities Working hours Full-time, with working days aligned to your department and rotation. Who You Are A recent graduate from any discipline, fluent in English (Maltese advantageous), proactive, organised, service-minded, adaptable and comfortable working in an international environment. What happens after the program? Successful graduates are considered for permanent opportunities including leadership roles in Malta, specialist functions and international careers across EF. About EF Many people in Malta know EF primarily as a language school – but we're much more than that. Since pioneering the concept of language travel in 1965, we've grown into the world's leading international education company, offering language learning, educational travel and cultural exchange opportunities for learners of all ages. Although we're now a global organization, we've never lost our entrepreneurial spirit. We encourage initiative, trust people with responsibility from an early stage, and create opportunities to grow across teams, functions and even countries. We're travelers, innovators, entrepreneurs and problem-solvers, united by one mission: Opening the world through education. We work hard, support one another, celebrate success – and never forget to enjoy the journey. EF is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to inclusion, belonging and sustainability. If you're looking for a place where you can learn, grow and make an impact, we'd love to welcome you to the EF family. EF is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults. All positions are subject to a criminal background and/or reference checks, as applicable. How To Apply Please submit your CV and a short cover letter explaining why EF Malta, what excites you about the program and where you'd like your career to be in 2–3 years.
